mounting.top_plane_proxy: Full 20 deg cone stays above body XY; no CAD/obstruction model

search.method: two independent elevation grid searches, then bounded Powell refinement
search.scope: azimuths fixed at 0 and 180 deg for a feasible +X/-X seed; full four-angle search is future work

integration_status: Explicit boresight evaluation supports this study; legacy configuration/main CLI still impose antipodal search. Refactor them next session before production use.
limitations: Feasible seed on a fixed path, not a jointly optimized trajectory or full four-angle global search
Top-plane clearance is not detailed structural, sunshade, plume or mutual-obstruction validation
Numerical grid/transition refinement is not a continuous-time proof
No tracker redundancy/fault-tolerance requirement was imposed; either may supply an update
